projects.name: MLOps Project – Vehicle Insurance Data Pipeline
projects.description: Built an end-to-end MLOps pipeline covering data ingestion from MongoDB, validation, transformation, model training, evaluation, and deployment using modular Python components. Implemented CI/CD automation with Docker and GitHub Actions; deployed models on AWS EC2 with S3-based model registry and ECR-backed container delivery.

projects.name: COVID-19 Chest X-Ray Classification
projects.description: Trained an EfficientNet-based transfer learning model to classify chest X-rays into COVID-19, Pneumonia, Lung Opacity, and Normal classes. Achieved 92.3% validation accuracy using fine-tuning and learning rate scheduling.

projects.name: Multi-PDF Chatbot
projects.description: Built a RAG-based chatbot capable of answering queries across multiple uploaded PDFs with conversational memory. Implemented FAISS-based vector retrieval for fast and accurate semantic search.
